title: Grateful Dead Live at Musikhalle on 1972-04-29

ai_review.summary: A sprawling, jazzy Dark Star and strong late‑show jams shine through a sub‑par SBD tape.
ai_review.review: The performance is musically satisfying – a near‑30‑minute Dark Star that wanders into Sugar Magnolia and a sizzling Caution, plus hot versions of Good Lovin' and Uncle John’s Band with Keith's fine piano work. The recording suffers from a degraded SBD source (B‑ grade) and needs EQ and a slight speed tweak, but it remains listenable for fans who prioritize the music over fidelity.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is praised (high energy, standout Dark Star and jams) while recording quality is noted as poor; weighted average yields a moderate rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Degraded SBD tape rated B‑, muffled/subdued sound, requires EQ tweaking and ~2.8% speed correction; overall listenable but not clear.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Long exploratory Dark Star segues into Sugar Magnolia and a sizzling Caution, maintaining strong momentum through the second half; transitions are praised.

band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's fine piano work is highlighted as a highlight of the performance.
